definitions.gloss: cold water; something that dampens enthusiasm
definitions.explanation: Cold water, now mostly in fixed expressions: throwing cold water on a plan or mood, or an old person overdoing something.

examples.japanese: {冷|ひ}や{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧。
examples.english: To be doused with cold water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{冷|ひ}や{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浴|あ}びせた。
examples.english: His remark threw cold water on the lively mood.

examples.japanese: {七十|ななじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧フルマラソン⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷|ひ}や{水|みず}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{笑|わら}われた→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: People laughed that running a full marathon past seventy was an old man overdoing it.

notes:
Usually figurative today; for drinking water, ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ or お{冷|ひ}や is the everyday word.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {冷|ひ}や{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浴|あ}びせる: to throw cold water on (a plan, a mood)
- {冷|ひ}や{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to be doused with cold water; to have one's hopes dampened
- ⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷|ひ}や{水|みず}: an old person doing something too strenuous for their age (literally, an old person bathing in cold water)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冷水|れいすい}→冷水：22480_reisui⟧: cold water (written and technical; ⟦{冷水|れいすい}→冷水：22480_reisui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浴|あ}びせる is also used)
